sources.snippet: JoyAI-Image is a unified multimodal foundation model for image understanding, text-to-image generation, and instruction-guided image editing. It combines an 8B Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) with a 16B Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT). sources.snippet: JoyAI-Image-Edit is JD Open Source's single-image instruction-guided editing model, combining 8B MLLM + 16B MMDiT. Available in BF16 and INT8 formats with native ComfyUI support.
